observations.finding: Upstream release R_2_9_0 (GitHub releases, 2026-10-05) lists two security fixes in its changelog: CVE-2026-102633 (integer overflow in expat_realloc on 32-bit platforms) and CVE-2026-77214 (validate the len parameter against the available buffer capacity in XML_ParseBuffer). It postdates the pin and the owner's rc.3 decision. The vcpkg registry's newest expat port is still 2.8.5 (registry commit 673823e1), so 2.9.0 cannot be selected through the pinned registry or an override at this time. Dependabot has no open expat 2.9.0 branch yet.
observations.apiScopeReading: mmxisf calls XML_Parse only (src/reader.cpp parse_header, 1 MiB chunks); it never calls XML_ParseBuffer or XML_GetBuffer. Supported targets are 64-bit only (macOS arm64, Linux amd64, Windows amd64), where the 32-bit realloc overflow is not applicable. This is a reading of the changelog titles; the CVE texts were not reviewed in full.
observations.ownerDecisionNeeded: Accept Expat 2.8.5 for v0.1.0 with this dated API-scoped disposition and schedule the 2.9.0 bump for the next mmxisf version, or hold the release until the registry provides 2.9.0 (rc.4 and a full rerun).
observations.verifiedChangelog: https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/blob/R_2_9_0/expat/Changes (2.9.0, 5 October 2026), verified by the repository lead: CVE-2026-102633 is an integer overflow in expat_realloc on 32-bit platforms only; CVE-2026-77214 is a missing len validation in XML_ParseBuffer (caller misuse).
